lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਇਹਾ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih karanee hovahi sarami(n)daa ihaa kamaanee reet ||
lines.translation: You have made it your habit to practice those deeds which will bring you shame.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t kee ni(n)daa saakat kee poojaa aisee driRhee bipareet ||1||
lines.translation: You slander the Saints, and you worship the faithless cynics; such are the corrupt ways you have adopted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭੂਲੋ ਅਵਰੈ ਹੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa moh bhoolo avarai heet ||
lines.translation: Deluded by your emotional attachment to Maya, you love other things,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ਰੇ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਬੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haricha(n)dauree ban har paat re ihai tuhaaro beet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: like the enchanted city of Hari-chandauree, or the green leaves of the forest - such is your way of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਗਰਧਭ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan lep hot deh kau sukh garadhabh bhasam sa(n)geet ||
lines.translation: Its body may be anointed with sandalwood oil, but the donkey still loves to roll in the mud.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit sa(n)g naahi ruch aavat bikhai thagauree preet ||2||
lines.translation: He is not fond of the Ambrosial Nectar; instead, he loves the poisonous drug of corruption. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: utam sa(n)t bhale sa(n)jogee is jug mahi pavit puneet ||
lines.translation: The Saints are noble and sublime; they are blessed with good fortune. They alone are pure and holy in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਜੀਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaat akaarath janam padaarath kaach baadarai jeet ||3||
lines.translation: The jewel of this human life is passing away uselessly, lost in exchange for mere glass. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh bhaage gur giaan a(n)jan netr deet ||
lines.translation: The sins and sorrows of uncounted incarnations run away, when the Guru applies the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to the eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਨ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g in dukh te nikasio naanak ek pareet ||4||9||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have escaped from these troubles; Nanak loves the One Lord. ||4||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai gun govi(n)d jas gaaee ||
lines.translation: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas man naam samhaarai ihu bisraam nidh paaee ||1||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in this way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumh karahu daiaa mere saaee ||
lines.translation: Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee mat deejai mere thaakur sadaa sadaa tudh dhiaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumhree kripaa te mohu maan chhootai binas jaai bharamaaee ||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anad roop ravio sabh madhe jat kat pekhau jaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go, there I see Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumh daiaal kirapaal kripaa nidh patit paavan gosaaee ||
lines.translation: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kot sookh aana(n)d raaj paae mukh te nimakh bulaaee ||3||
lines.translation: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant Your Name with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaap taap bhagat saa pooree jo prabh kai man bhaaee ||
lines.translation: That alone is perfect chanting, meditation, penance and devotional worship service, which is pleasing to God's Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat trisanaa sabh bujhee hai naanak tripat aghaaee ||4||10||
lines.translation: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਵਸਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਵਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keene vas apunai trai gun bhavan chatur sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: She controls the three qualities and the four directions of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਤਾਪ ਥਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jag isanaan taap thaan kha(n)de kiaa ihu ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: She destroys sacrificial feasts, cleansing baths, penances and sacred places of pilgrimage; what is this poor person to do? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kee ot gahee tau chhooto ||
lines.translation: I grasped God's Support and Protection, and then I was emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਬ ਹੂਟੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh prasaad har har har gaae bikhai biaadh tab hooto ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Holy Saints, I sang the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and my sins and afflictions were taken away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬਕੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਉਹ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah suneeai nah mukh te bakeeai nah mohai uh deethee ||
lines.translation: She is not heard - she does not speak with a mouth; she is not seen enticing mortals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aisee thagauree paai bhulaavai man sabh kai laagai meethee ||2||
lines.translation: She administers her intoxicating drug, and so confuses them; thus she seems sweet to everyone's mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਉਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਦੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maai baap poot hit bhraataa un ghar ghar melio dooaa ||
lines.translation: In each and every home, she has implanted the sense of duality in mother, father, children, friends and siblings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਾਧਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਰਿ ਲਰਿ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee vaadh ghaat kis hee pahi sagale lar lar mooaa ||3||
lines.translation: Some have more, and some have less; they fight and fight, to the death. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin ihu chalat dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown me this wondrous play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਭਗਤ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: goojhee bhaahi jalai sa(n)saaraa bhagat na biaapai maaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: The world is being consumed by this hidden fire, but Maya does not cling to the Lord's devotees. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad mahaa sukh paaiaa sagale ba(n)dhan kaate ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained supreme bliss, and all my bonds have been broken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਖਾਟੇ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam naanak dhan paaiaa apunai ghar lai aaiaa khaate ||5||11||
lines.translation: Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; having earned his profits, he has now returned home. ||5||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਨਾਇਕ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum daate thaakur pratipaalak naaik khasam hamaare ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver, O Lord, O Cherisher, my Master, my Husband Lord.
